single_threshold_source.scope: PoPu P6 single-checkpoint reject rule for small_resnet at record level.

ensemble_rule_source.scope: PoPu P6.1 calibrated_mean_plus_unanimous: temperature=0.75, threshold=0.5 (rules[1] unanimity branch), require_unanimous=true. rules[0] pre-unanimity threshold is never applied here.

stitching.rationale: Stitch every (repeat, local_fold, condition, seed) record row across all 15 folds into one frame before computing macro-F1, balanced accuracy, WAR, per-class and per-subject. Never average per-fold metrics.

report: record macro-F1, balanced accuracy and accuracy (computed on stitched OOF)
delta from clean baseline at stitched level
P6 single-checkpoint coverage, accepted accuracy and WAR
P6.1 ensemble coverage, accepted accuracy and WAR (unanimity consistency rule)
per-class and per-subject degradation on stitched OOF
condition seed mean, standard deviation and worst case
decision: sensitivity characterization only; no hardware PASS claim without real sensor tolerances
boundary: software perturbation of PoPu 64x27 Tactilus matrices is not validation of a real low-density or faulty product sensor
